hero.title: I turn fuzzy ideas into working software people can try.
hero.lede: I am a creative technologist — Founder & Principal Architect, and a principal and distinguished software engineer and software architect — who blends front-end craft, full-stack architecture, and creative technology to move ideas from sketch to shipped experience.

intro.heading: Building at the edge of possible and practical
paragraphs: I work best where product ambition, user experience, and technical uncertainty meet. As Founder & Principal Architect of an AI-first technology consultancy, I lead software and UI architecture, agentic interface design, frontend modernization, and specialized engineering delivery for modern products.

As a creative technologist — and as a principal / distinguished software engineer and software architect — that has meant building interactive prototypes, event-driven digital releases, data-rich visualizations, and exploratory XR/3D concepts at Nike that help teams validate what should become real.

Before that, I shipped gaming interfaces, fintech dashboards, media playback systems, healthcare tools, internal business apps, and client websites. The throughline is simple: make complex systems feel usable, fast, and alive.

experienceIntro: A combined view of the resume files, edited into a shorter story of impact and range.

highlights: Founded and lead an AI-first technology consultancy focused on software architecture, intelligent user interfaces, agentic systems, frontend modernization, and specialized engineering delivery.
Define software and UI architecture, technical requirements, delivery strategy, staffing, milestones, and engineering standards for client engagements.
Design agentic AI and human-centered interfaces with emphasis on transparency, user control, system state, approval workflows, and responsible automation.
Lead advanced frontend architecture across interactive applications, design systems, browser-based media, real-time visualization, 3D, WebXR, and spatial-computing technologies.
Built Vue.js front ends and Python/AWS Lambda services with DynamoDB for rapid concept validation in the Technology Innovations Office.
Supported the Nike Sport Moment Experiences (SME) team with event-driven, promotional, and marketing releases across digital platforms.
Created proofs of concept across immersive XR, dynamic 3D modeling, advanced data visualization, and generative AI to inform future product directions.
Developed TypeScript, JavaScript, and React components for responsive gaming experiences focused on performance and player retention.
Authored design documents, code documentation, and unit tests with TypeDoc, Jest, and related tooling to support reliable delivery.
Engineered reusable React interfaces for Bittrex.com and data-rich cryptocurrency exchange workflows.
Built Microsoft-platform business sites with React, MobX, Node.js, web sockets, microservices, and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
Led video playback and interactive feature work for NBCNews.com, Today.com, and MSNBC.com with responsive, cross-browser delivery.
Created an internal JavaScript library for a modular reusable video player framework with media compliance constraints.

workStyle.heading: How I work
workStyle.body: I like crisp requirements, fast prototypes, practical documentation, and code that helps the next person move faster. Fun is welcome; ambiguity is expected; shipping still matters.
